In US for veterinary use only. USP 31 (Mibolerone). A white to off-white powder. Practically insoluble in water; slightly soluble in chloroform, in dioxan, and in dichloromethane. Profile Mibolerone is an androgen that is used in veterinary practice as a contraceptive for female dogs. It also has anabolic properties.
